## 1. Start
Runs by hand or every hour. The hourly run continues only at the hour and days set in the `Config` tab.

## 2. Read the sheet
Users, their topics and the list of feeds.

## 3. Pick the news
Reads each feed once, then picks the newest articles for each user.

## 4. Summarise with AI
Ollama rewrites one article at a time in the user's language and level. If a call fails, the original text stays.

## 5. Vocabulary
For users who read in English, Ollama picks 5 difficult words from today's summaries and gives their Spanish meaning. Other users skip the call.

## 6. Email
Builds one HTML email per user, with the labels in the user's language, and sends it with Gmail. Users with no articles get no email.
